clauses.clauseText: JoeCoder is an exceptional, general-purpose, production-proven autonomous coding agent.
blockers: The complete real-project, provider, UI, release-payload, and clean-Windows qualification sequence is incomplete.

clauses.clauseText: The user chooses a build folder and Joe begins a read-only inspection.
blockers: Implemented and fixture-tested, but not bound to a current final-product UI receipt.

clauses.clauseText: One ordinary-language request in Automatic mode advances one bounded job and reports proof and remaining uncertainty.
blockers: Fixture execution exists; the three required substantial real-project jobs are unproven.

clauses.clauseText: Ask and Plan remain read-only, and Stop and Resume are the only normal job controls.
blockers: Source and structural tests exist; current interactive UI qualification is absent.

clauses.clauseText: Mutation is confined by an exact sealed scope, a project path jail, typed operations, and explicit budgets.
blockers: Controls are implemented, but current compiled governed-tool tests include failures and earlier receipts are not yet rebound to this candidate.

clauses.clauseText: Affected files are snapshotted before mutation and failed work restores byte-identical prior state.
blockers: Unit-level behavior exists; current-candidate re-certification and exact-payload interruption proof remain outstanding.

clauses.clauseText: The model proposes work while deterministic server policy owns authorization and terminal truth.
blockers: Mechanism is implemented; full current release verification does not pass.

clauses.clauseText: Project content, model output, memory, and provider errors cannot grant authority or disclose protected secrets.
blockers: Adversarial fixtures exist, but live two-provider error and fallback evidence is absent.

clauses.clauseText: Durable jobs survive interruption and resume from committed checkpoints without duplicate actions, writes, or charges.
blockers: Fixture interruption coverage exists; the exact signed release payload interruption matrix is unproven.

clauses.clauseText: Joe independently investigates and produces the smallest evidence-backed plan from the actual project state.
blockers: Fixture behavior is present; substantial real-project evidence is absent.

clauses.clauseText: Joe edits, runs project-native checks, diagnoses failure, and performs bounded correction without routine user intervention.
blockers: The current release test suite fails and the required real-project jobs have not been completed.

clauses.clauseText: A substantial cross-layer repair succeeds on a disposable copy of a real operator project under pre-sealed criteria and an independent oracle.
blockers: No qualifying current Stage 2 repair receipt exists.

clauses.clauseText: A substantial cross-cutting refactor succeeds on a disposable copy of a real operator project under pre-sealed criteria and an independent oracle.
blockers: No qualifying current Stage 2 refactor receipt exists.

clauses.clauseText: A substantial greenfield application starts, handles real input, persists state where applicable, and survives restart under pre-sealed criteria and an independent oracle.
blockers: No qualifying current Stage 2 greenfield receipt exists.

clauses.clauseText: Pre-existing project tests are hash-frozen, and modification requires recorded justification and operator approval.
blockers: The required real-project test inventories and operator-reviewed exceptions do not exist.

clauses.clauseText: Every evidentiary receipt is preserved in the repository certification directory and recorded by hash in the signed append-only manifest.
blockers: The existing 819-entry manifest verifies, but the new Stage 1 baseline receipt has not yet been created and appended.

clauses.clauseText: Evidence tags and receipts are immutable; existing tags are never moved or reused, and missing or unmanifested receipts carry no weight.
blockers: Manifest immutability is implemented; unique current RC tag creation and wrong-tag negative proof remain pending.

clauses.clauseText: The final workflow is usable at all four required viewports without primary horizontal overflow and within the action-count thresholds.
blockers: No current signed Stage 3 viewport and workflow-economy receipt exists.

clauses.clauseText: Every interactive element has visible focus, the required keyboard path works, and text contrast meets the specified thresholds in every state.
blockers: No current signed accessibility, keyboard, and measured-contrast receipt exists; browser-tool tests currently fail.

clauses.clauseText: The pre-mutation authorization sentence matches the persisted envelope, active-job messages are classified visibly, and Joe Live follows committed events.
blockers: No signed browser-to-SQLite event comparison or active-message classification receipt exists.

clauses.clauseText: Failure after a committed checkpoint reroutes between two genuinely eligible live providers only when sealed policy permits it.
blockers: No current live receipt proves two eligible providers and real failure rerouting.

clauses.clauseText: Provider cancellation, durable resume, no-fallback safe stop, cost reconciliation, and secret-safe errors are proved with live providers.
blockers: Only mocked provider tests are present for these combined behaviors.

clauses.clauseText: Every partial law receives an operator decision to retain its boundary or implement executable enforcement with an adversarial test.
blockers: The current 20 partial-law boundaries have not been reviewed and decided for this candidate by the operator.

clauses.clauseText: Copied real legacy databases migrate forward with preserved evidence chains, atomic failed-migration rollback, and documented recovery behavior.
blockers: Synthetic migration tests exist, but no copied real legacy database qualification receipt exists.

clauses.clauseText: The exact candidate payload has complete checksums, signed metadata, dependency inventory, provenance, and truthful test identities.
blockers: Signing and checksum mechanisms exist; release provenance can currently name tests not run by release:build, and the full suite fails.

clauses.clauseText: The exact signed payload survives interruption at every durable transition without duplicate writes, receipts, or charges.
blockers: No complete interruption receipt exists for the exact future signed candidate payload.

clauses.clauseText: The signed payload is installed and qualified under a separately provisioned clean Windows identity without reading development-tree files.
blockers: No current receipt records a disposable SID or VM identity with clean cache and payload-only access.

clauses.clauseText: Only the operator issues the mandate-compliance verdict after every required clause is proven or explicitly ratified.
blockers: All downstream qualification stages and the final operator decision remain open.
